title: Closing the Software Development Deal
theme: Software Development Sales and Client Acquisition

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Hi Andi, thanks for making the time to meet today. How's your week been so far?
dialogue.indonesian: Halo Andi, terima kasih sudah meluangkan waktu untuk bertemu hari ini. Bagaimana kabar minggu Anda sejauh ini?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: It's been quite busy, actually. We've been preparing for the next quarter. How about you?
dialogue.indonesian: Cukup sibuk, sejujurnya. Kami sedang bersiap untuk kuartal berikutnya. Bagaimana dengan Anda?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I can imagine. It’s the same over here at the software house, but I always enjoy the energy of new projects.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya bisa bayangkan. Sama halnya di software house kami, tapi saya selalu menikmati energi dari proyek-proyek baru.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: That's good to hear. I saw your recent post about the fintech app you launched. Impressive work.
dialogue.indonesian: Senang mendengarnya. Saya melihat unggahan terbaru Anda tentang aplikasi fintech yang baru diluncurkan. Kerja yang luar biasa.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Thank you! That was a challenging but rewarding build. It actually reminds me of what we discussed briefly last time.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih! Itu adalah pengembangan yang menantang tapi memuaskan. Sebenarnya itu mengingatkan saya pada apa yang sempat kita bahas sebelumnya.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Right, our internal management system. We are still struggling with the manual processes.
dialogue.indonesian: Benar, sistem manajemen internal kami. Kami masih kesulitan dengan proses-proses manual.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Manual processes can really slow down growth. What is the biggest bottleneck you're facing right now?
dialogue.indonesian: Proses manual benar-benar bisa menghambat pertumbuhan. Apa kendala terbesar yang Anda hadapi saat ini?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Mostly data synchronization between departments. It leads to a lot of human errors.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebagian besar adalah sinkronisasi data antar departemen. Hal itu menyebabkan banyak kesalahan manusia.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I see. A custom ERP solution could definitely bridge those gaps and automate the data flow.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya mengerti. Solusi ERP kustom pasti bisa menjembatani celah tersebut dan mengotomatiskan aliran data.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: We've handled similar issues for clients in your industry, ensuring high security and zero data loss.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami telah menangani masalah serupa untuk klien di industri Anda, menjamin keamanan tinggi dan tanpa kehilangan data.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: That sounds like exactly what we need, but I'm concerned about the transition period and the cost.
dialogue.indonesian: Kedengarannya persis seperti yang kami butuhkan, tapi saya khawatir tentang masa transisi dan biayanya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Understandable. We offer a phased implementation to minimize disruption to your daily operations.
dialogue.indonesian: Bisa dimaklumi. Kami menawarkan implementasi bertahap untuk meminimalkan gangguan pada operasional harian Anda.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Regarding cost, think of it as an investment that will save you hundreds of man-hours every month.
dialogue.indonesian: Mengenai biaya, anggaplah ini sebagai investasi yang akan menghemat ratusan jam kerja setiap bulannya.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: If you put it that way, the ROI does seem significant. How long would development take?
dialogue.indonesian: Jika Anda menyampaikannya seperti itu, ROI-nya memang tampak signifikan. Berapa lama pengembangannya?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Based on your requirements, we can have a Minimum Viable Product ready in about three months.
dialogue.indonesian: Berdasarkan kebutuhan Anda, kami bisa menyiapkan Minimum Viable Product dalam waktu sekitar tiga bulan.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: That is faster than I expected. Does that include training for my staff?
dialogue.indonesian: Itu lebih cepat dari yang saya duga. Apakah itu sudah termasuk pelatihan untuk staf saya?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Absolutely. We provide full documentation and hands-on training sessions for your team.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu saja. Kami menyediakan dokumentasi lengkap dan sesi pelatihan langsung untuk tim Anda.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: We want to make sure everyone is comfortable using the new system from day one.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami ingin memastikan semua orang merasa nyaman menggunakan sistem baru tersebut sejak hari pertama.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: I appreciate the thoroughness. What about maintenance after the launch?
dialogue.indonesian: Saya menghargai ketelitiannya. Bagaimana dengan pemeliharaan setelah peluncuran?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: We offer a dedicated support package to ensure the software stays updated and secure.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami menawarkan paket dukungan khusus untuk memastikan perangkat lunak tetap mutakhir dan aman.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Okay, that addresses my main concerns. I like your approach to this project.
dialogue.indonesian: Baiklah, itu menjawab kekhawatiran utama saya. Saya suka pendekatan Anda terhadap proyek ini.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I'm glad to hear that. I really believe we can help your company scale more efficiently.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya senang mendengarnya. Saya benar-benar percaya kami bisa membantu perusahaan Anda berkembang lebih efisien.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Should I draft a formal proposal and contract for you to review by tomorrow?
dialogue.indonesian: Haruskah saya membuat draf proposal formal dan kontrak untuk Anda tinjau besok?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Yes, please do. If the terms match what we discussed, I'm ready to sign.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, silakan. Jika persyaratannya sesuai dengan yang kita diskusikan, saya siap menandatanganinya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Great. I'll get my team started on the initial architecture plan right away.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Saya akan segera meminta tim saya mulai mengerjakan rencana arsitektur awal.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Perfect. I'm looking forward to seeing this system come to life.
dialogue.indonesian: Sempurna. Saya menantikan sistem ini menjadi kenyataan.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Me too. I'll send over the documents by tomorrow morning. It was a pleasure talking with you.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya juga. Saya akan mengirimkan dokumennya besok pagi. Senang bisa berbicara dengan Anda.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: The pleasure is mine. Thanks for the insights today.
dialogue.indonesian: Sama-sama. Terima kasih atas wawasannya hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: You're very welcome. Have a productive rest of your day, Andi.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih kembali. Semoga sisa hari Anda produktif, Andi.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: You too. See you soon!
dialogue.indonesian: Anda juga. Sampai jumpa lagi!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Actually, before I head out, do you have any specific integrations in mind?
dialogue.indonesian: Sebenarnya, sebelum saya pergi, apakah Anda memiliki integrasi khusus dalam pikiran?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Ah, yes. It needs to work with our existing accounting software if possible.
dialogue.indonesian: Ah, ya. Itu harus bisa bekerja dengan perangkat lunak akuntansi kami yang sudah ada jika memungkinkan.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: That shouldn't be a problem. We can use APIs to ensure seamless data transfer.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu seharusnya tidak menjadi masalah. Kita bisa menggunakan API untuk memastikan transfer data yang mulus.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Excellent. That would save us even more time on financial reporting.
dialogue.indonesian: Luar biasa. Itu akan lebih menghemat waktu kami dalam pelaporan keuangan.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Exactly. We'll make sure to include that in the technical scope of the proposal.
dialogue.indonesian: Tepat sekali. Kami akan memastikan untuk menyertakan hal itu dalam cakupan teknis proposalnya.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Sounds good. I feel much more confident about our digital transformation now.
dialogue.indonesian: Kedengarannya bagus. Saya merasa jauh lebih percaya diri tentang transformasi digital kami sekarang.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Confidence is key. We are here to support your vision every step of the way.
dialogue.indonesian: Kepercayaan diri adalah kunci. Kami di sini untuk mendukung visi Anda di setiap langkah.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: I appreciate the partnership. Let's make this happen.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya menghargai kemitraan ini. Mari kita wujudkan.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Let's do it. Talk to you soon, Andi.
dialogue.indonesian: Mari kita lakukan. Sampai bicara lagi nanti, Andi.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Take care. Goodbye.
dialogue.indonesian: Hati-hati. Selamat tinggal.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Goodbye!
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat tinggal!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: One last thing, do you prefer email or a physical copy of the contract?
dialogue.indonesian: Satu hal terakhir, apakah Anda lebih suka email atau salinan fisik kontraknya?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Email is fine for now. We can sign it digitally to speed things up.
dialogue.indonesian: Email saja cukup untuk sekarang. Kita bisa menandatanganinya secara digital untuk mempercepat proses.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Perfect, I'll use a secure e-signature platform.
dialogue.indonesian: Sempurna, saya akan menggunakan platform tanda tangan elektronik yang aman.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: That works for me. Looking forward to it.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu cocok bagi saya. Saya menantikannya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: We'll also set up a kickoff meeting for next week with both our teams.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami juga akan menjadwalkan pertemuan awal untuk minggu depan dengan tim kita masing-masing.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Good idea. I'll involve my IT lead so they can sync up with your developers.
dialogue.indonesian: Ide bagus. Saya akan melibatkan kepala IT saya supaya mereka bisa sinkron dengan pengembang Anda.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: That's very helpful. Direct communication will make the process much smoother.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu sangat membantu. Komunikasi langsung akan membuat prosesnya jauh lebih lancar.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Agreed. I'll tell them to expect an invite.
dialogue.indonesian: Setuju. Saya akan memberitahu mereka untuk menunggu undangannya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Will do. Thanks again for the trust, Andi.
dialogue.indonesian: Akan saya laksanakan. Terima kasih lagi atas kepercayaannya, Andi.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: You've earned it with your track record. Let's build something great.
dialogue.indonesian: Anda layak mendapatkannya dengan rekam jejak Anda. Mari kita bangun sesuatu yang hebat.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: We certainly will. Have a wonderful afternoon.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami pasti akan melakukannya. Semoga sore Anda menyenangkan.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Thanks, you too. Goodbye.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih, Anda juga. Selamat tinggal.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Goodbye, Andi.
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat tinggal, Andi.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Wait, I just remembered, we might need a mobile version later on too.
dialogue.indonesian: Tunggu, saya baru ingat, kami mungkin butuh versi mobile juga nantinya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: We can build the backend to be mobile-ready from the start, so adding an app later is easy.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami bisa membangun backend-nya agar siap untuk mobile sejak awal, jadi menambah aplikasi nantinya akan mudah.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: That's forward-thinking. I like that.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu pemikiran yang maju. Saya suka itu.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: We always aim for scalability. I'll make sure that's noted.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami selalu mengutamakan skalabilitas. Saya akan pastikan hal itu dicatat.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.english: Excellent. Okay, now I really must get to my next call.
dialogue.indonesian: Luar biasa. Oke, sekarang saya benar-benar harus lanjut ke telepon berikutnya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Of course. Thank you for your time, Andi. Speak soon.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu saja. Terima kasih atas waktu Anda, Andi. Bicara lagi segera.
